svg.title: Ἡ Ἀσία· ἀπὸ Σάρδεων εἰς Κιλικίαν
svg.desc: Map of the Aegean coast of Asia Minor drawn from Natural Earth coastline data (public domain): Sardis inland, Ephesus and Miletus on the coast, the Chersonese peninsula in the north-west, the Pisidians in the mountains to the south-east, Cilicia on the south coast further east, and the sea to the west. The march route is not yet drawn.
